articleTitle: SAR Target Recognition with Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In convolutional neural network (CNN)-based synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target recognition, a large number of SAR image datasets are required to train the CNN. To deal with the problem of insufficient training datasets, a generative adversarial network (GAN) can be applied for data augmentation. In this paper, the performance of SAR target recognition with GAN-based data augmentation is investigated using the MSTAR datasets. The results show that, by applying the GAN-based data augmentation using a proper data augmentation factor, a target recognition accuracy as high as 99.38% can be achieved, which is improved by 2.35% compared to the condition without data augmentation. Thus, the GAN-based data augmentation provides a promising solution to enhancing the accuracy of SAR target recognition.

articleTitle: Modulation Recognition Analysis Based on Neural Networks and Improved Model
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the emergence and development of computer technology, software technology and other technologies, there are a number of new solutions to the problem of modulation recognition. Modulation recognition is a key step in digital signal processing. The traditional recognition method based on likelihood ratio decision theory has gradually been replaced by the recognition method based on neural network. In this paper, for the recognition of modulation signals, in the PyTorch framework, Convolutional Neural Networks and Residual Neural Network are used to identify modulation signals and test the accuracy. In addition, the advantages and disadvantages of the two models for modulation signal recognition performance are compared, and the model is improved at the same time. In this paper, linear layers with different parameters are added to the Convolutional Neural Networks to observe the impact of its recognition rate and loss function, and a new improvement direction for the recognition of modulation signal datasets is proposed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Mode-Locked 2μm Fiber Laser Based on Nonlinear Polarization Rotation and Semiconductor Saturable Absorber Mirror
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a passively mode-locked thulium/holmium co-doped fiber (THDF) laser based on the combination of the nonlinear polarization rotation (NPR) and the semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM). The wavelength tunable range is 42nm in the single pulse mode-locked state. In an all-anomalous-dispersion cavity, dual-wavelength soliton pulses centered around at 1894.15 nm and 1938.4 nm with 3 dB bandwidths of 0.47 nm and 1.1 nm are observed. By adjusting polarization controllers (PC), multi-pulse mode locking and harmonic mode locking (HML) are also obtained.

articleTitle: A deep learning-based approach with PSO for workload prediction of containers in the cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Workload prediction is a critical task for cloud services providers, which aims to accurately estimate the workload of containers and place or migrate containers in a suitable way. In this paper, we present a prediction method based on deep learning and hyper-parameter tuning termed PSL. This method consists of Savitzky-Golay filter (SG filter), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and hyper-parameter tuning powered by Particle Swarm optimization (PSO). First, time series are normalized and smoothed by Savitzky-Golay Filter. Next, the time series are fed into LSTM to predict the workload. In addition, in order to improve the prediction performance of the model, PSO is employed for hyper-parameter tuning. We adopt Alibaba cluster 2018 traces for experiments and verify the effectiveness of the model. Experimental results show that automatic hyper-parameter tuning can improve the prediction performance of the PSL. Meanwhile, the prediction performance of the PSL is better than SL (the PSL without hyper-parameter tuning) by 19.3%, 4%, 11.7% in MSE, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, MAE respectively. In addition, the prediction performance of the PSL outperforms other methods, including RNN, GRU and LSTM.

articleTitle: Modeling for Underwater Optical Channel in Relatively Turbid Waters Based on the Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the development of marine research and exploitation, underwater optical communications have been widely used in numerous scenes. However, seawater would absorb and scatter the optical signal, causing the energy attenuation and the time-domain broadening of the pulse. In this work, based on the basic optical properties of seawater, the Monte Carlo method is applied to simulate the energy attenuation and the time-domain response of the light pulse in relatively turbid waters. The feasibility of optical communication in relatively turbid waters is estimated, with an interesting finding that the requirement for optical link alignment can be significantly relaxed in turbid waters.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of UDP Protocol in Embedded Real-Time OS
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: At present, most applications that require fast network transmission use the User Datagram Protocol (UDP) at the transport layer. However, many network transmissions rely on simple traversal to find and fill UDP protocol messages, which are prone to errors and not stable enough, especially in embedded real-time OS. Based on the analysis of the UDP network protocol framework, this article focuses on the instability of the UDP protocol application, designs a UDP control block and a functional framework specifically for UDP protocol transmission, and finally implements the test in the VxWorks environment, and the results prove to be improved Stability of UDP protocol function realization.

articleTitle: Cascadable multiplexing two-dimensional vector sensor based on multi-core optical fiber in compliant cylinder structure
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Vector vibration sensing is playing an increasingly important role in scientific measurement and engineering applications. Due to their outstanding intrinsic merits of electromagnetic immunity, remote operation capability, compact size and high sensitivity, fiber-optic vibration sensors have attracted much attention. In this paper, a two-dimensional vector vibration sensor based on multi-core fiber (MCF) Bragg gratings is proposed. The sensor can obtain the vibration azimuthal angle and the acceleration by monitoring the wavelength shifts of two cores of the MCF. The resonance frequency of the proposed sensor is 18Hz, and the linear sensitivity is 73.8 pm/g at 30 Hz. Moreover, it can be easy to realize multiple point-position cascaded multiplexing owing to the compliant cylindrical structure.

articleTitle: Architectures and Use cases of AI-based Network
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The development of AI in communication networks is inseparable from the support of standardization. This article introduces network AI functions and use cases based on standard research. It firstly summarizes the research of implementations, algorithms, and optimizations of AI nowdays, which clarifies the network development goal of realizing AI functions in the future. Secondly, the brief explaination of SON and detailed explication of MDA and AI networked architecture design of the core network and RAN are introduced. Then the paper highlights UE trajectory prediction and smart energy-saving use cases of the wireless network, and it mainly focuses on the comparative study of algorithms and signaling realization. Last but not the least, the intelligent network platform enriches the ideas for future development of providing more reliable networks to vertical industries.

articleTitle: Based on Brillouin Scattering Photoelectric Research of Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Photoelectric oscillator is a microwave photonic signal generation technology that converts optical energy into microwave energy through photoelectric feedback loop. Photoelectric oscillator (OEO) can be used as a high-performance signal source and has a wide range of applications. Therefore, a dual loop polarization multiplexed photoelectric oscillator based on stimulated Brillouin scattering of optical fiber is proposed, which improves the quality of microwave signal generated by photoelectric oscillator, improves the side mode rejection ratio and tunable range, indicating that the performance of microwave signal generated by polarization multiplexed dual loop photoelectric oscillator is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Atmospheric Turbulence Simulation Experiment Based on Liquid Crystal Spatial Light Modulator
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this letter, an atmospheric turbulence simulation equipment based on a liquid crystal spatial light modulator is studied. We use fast Fourier transform to generate a phase screen, and uses the subharmonic method to compensate for its low-frequency components. The influence of different turbulence intensities on laser atmospheric transmission is successfully-demonstrated. The far-field spot and received power of Gaussian beams under simulated atmospheric turbulence with different intensity are measured through actual experiments. The experimental results show that the spot will be distorted, and the received power at the receiving end will be jittered in varying degrees.

articleTitle: Investigation on All-Fiber Holmium Doped Fiber Laser Based on Nonlinear Polarization Rotation
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We present a mode-locked holmium-doped all-fiber and all-anomalous dispersion soliton laser operating in the 2089 nm wavelength range based on nonlinear polarization rotation. By optimizing the 1915 nm thulium-doped laser for efficient in-band pumping in a subsequent holmium-doped fiber laser, the optical amplification in 2.1 $\mu$m band is obtained. Nonlinear polarization rotation structure realize the filter and mode-locking, a pulse with a repetition frequency of 20.89 MHz and pulse energy of 4 nJ is realized. By increasing the pump power, the 11-order harmonic soliton mode locking is obtained.

articleTitle: Small Data Transmission in Inactive State
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: 5G wireless network needs higher requirements on the capacity, latency and efficiency. In NR, RRC_INACTIVE is introduced to reduce the latency and signaling overhead. Unfortunately, the infrequent data transmission is generally maintained by the network during RRC_INACTIVE state. Always resume the connection for each data transmission and then release it to INACTIVE state will result in unnecessary power consumption and signaling overhead. To improve the efficiency, the small data transmission (SDT) is proposed during the INACTIVE state. The paper introduces the overall procedure SDT. Then, details are analyzed in terms of subsequent transmission, cell reselection, timers and anchor relocation.

articleTitle: Path Selection for Hybrid Fiber Communication/Sensing Network
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: It is very important to choose the optimal transmission path in the transmission process of fiber network. It can not only improve the ability of fiber sensing and communication, but also has great significance for the improvement of communication efficiency. This paper proposes an intelligent path selection method, which can obtain all path state information between target nodes, and then select the optimal path. A path is made up of links and nodes. Firstly, a fuzzy logic system with link failure judgment ability is constructed based on the network topology and sensing capability parameters to obtain the failure probability of each link. The parameters of link failure probability, path length, path hops and path failure probability are successively overlaid and selected step by step. Finally, the optimal transmission path between the initial nodes is selected.

articleTitle: The Pressure Sensing Method Based on Polarization Properties in Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The focus of this talk is on the method and technologies of pressure sensor based on polarization properties in fiber. The working principle is the proportional relationship between Stokes parameters and applied pressure. Hence real-time pressure measurement is achieved through direct measurement of the Stokes parameters. Using a cantilever beam the displacement measuring is also achieved. The optimizations of the sensor are discussed. The measurement range is increased by 5 times using the fusion of multi-Stokes parameters. In addition, aiming at improving both sensitivity and linearity, a novel and fast optimization scheme for the optimal incident SOP (state of polarization) is proposed, which is based on the Muller matrix instead of the previous “blind adjustment The sensitivity and linearity obtained in the vibration experiments agree well with the theoretical expectation. In order to meet the requirement for monitoring high frequency dynamic pressure or transient pressure, a design using a PBS (polarization beam splitter) is proposed to demodulate the polarization information. The simple and all-fiber configuration, low-cost and high-speed potential make it promising for fiber-based dynamic pressure sensing. And this type of sensor has potential for measurement of other measurand, e.g. acceleration, acoustic and ultrasonic signal. We also take a look at the future prospective at the research directions and challenges in this area at last.

articleTitle: Edge Detection of Chinese Herbal Medicine Microscopic Images Based on Multiscale Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to accurately and effectively extract the edge of target information in the microscopic image of Chinese herbal medicines (CHM), an edge detection algorithm based on multiscale wavelet transform was proposed. Firstly, a mathematical model was established, and the appropriate wavelet function and scale parameters were selected using the characteristics of wavelet transform. Secondly, large number microscopic images of CHM were edge detection; the results are compared with those of classical edge detection algorithms such as Roberts, Sobel, Prewitt, Laplace and Gaussian Laplace detection. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has good edge continuity, good anti-noise performance and accurate edge location. Its performance is superior to that of classical edge detection algorithms, and can accurately detect the edge of medical image.

articleTitle: Research on Pulse Position Modulation and Demodulation System of Space Laser Communication Based on DBN-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The pulse position modulation (PPM) demodulation system for space laser communication based on the cascade of deep belief network (DBN) and support vector machine (SVM) is studied in this paper, and a simulation system of space laser communication is established, and then a demodulator based on DBN-SVM is proposed. The lognormal atmospheric channel is simulated in MATLAB to simulate atmospheric turbulence channel, and the bit error rate of pulse position modulation signal affected by atmospheric turbulence is analyzed. The system performance is evaluated by comparing the average Signal to noise ratio and bit error ratio of different algorithms. In the DBNSVM based demodulator, the received signal is normalized before it is sent to the deep belief network. The processed signal data set is used to train the deep belief network parameters layer by layer to realize the feature extraction and recognition of the pulse position modulation signal. Then, the feature matrix is classified by support vector machine to obtain the demodulation result. The simulation results show that the demodulator based on DBN-SVM can effectively alleviate the influence of channel fading. Numerical simulation shows that DBN-SVM detection algorithm is superior to the least mean square error method and approximate to the maximum likelihood detection algorithm in atmospheric turbulence, which verifies the good performance of DBN-SVM detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Fractional-Order Intermittent Chaos Implementation in Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Fractiona1-order chaotic systems are often designed to synchronize with integer-order chaotic systems for applications such as chaotic secure communication and weak signal detection. Therefore, the implementation of fractional-order chaotic systems is of great importance. in this paper, the Duffing chaotic systems with the fractional derivative of order 0.9 are presented. A method of implementing the fractional-order chaotic systems in Simulink is given. By observing the phase and time series diagrams, we analyze the systems and obtain the values of critical thresholds for these systems, where the intermittent chaotic phenomena occurring under different parameter conditions are illustrated. Contribute to the realization of fractional-order Duffing systems for further applications on Simulink.

articleTitle: Study on Luminescence Properties of Tb³⁺, Yb³⁺ Doped CeF₃ Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A series of CeF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanoparticles doped with Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> were synthesized by hydrothermal method. The phase structure, morphology and optical properties of the samples were measured by X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and photoluminescence spectroscopy (PL). The results show that the synthesized samples are of high quality. After doping, the crystal lattice was not changed significantly, and the sample presented the oblate shape. With the increase of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ion doping concentration, the green emission intensity of Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> was effectively enhanced, and the mechanism of enhanced luminescence was further explored according to the spectrum. This research provides potential applications for CeF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> materials in visible light illumination display, laser output and optical communication.

articleTitle: Study on DSR Square Wave Pulse Compression in Er-doped NALM Mode-Locked Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We first demonstrate the compression of square wave dissipative soliton resonance pulse in Er-doped NALM mode-locked fiber laser. The pulse width can be tuned from 0.712 ns to 1.881 ns by adjusting the polarization controller in the cavity, and different pulse width corresponds to different operating power from 25.02 mW to 27.99 mW in the cavity. It is found that there is an optimal operating power 26.82 mW for the square wave pulse to obtain the maximum compression ratio 18.98% of pulse width.

articleTitle: Recognition of Third-Party Interference in Cable Monitoring Based on 1-D CNN with Fiber Optic DAS System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A pattern recognition method based on 1-D CNN for third-party interference is proposed and demonstrated. Assisted with fiber optic distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system, the average recognition with 97.2% for five events and 1. 5ms processing time of a 1-D sample are realized in the field test, and the traffic flow information is achieved basically.

articleTitle: Preparation and Characterization of Silica Fiber Reinforced Boron Modified Methyl Phenolic Resin Matrix Composites
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Methyl phenolic resin and boron modified methyl phenolic resin were synthesized by solution polymerization using m-cresol, formaldehyde and boric acid as raw materials, and quartz fiber reinforced resin matrix composites were prepared using the two resins as matrix. The structure of the resin was characterized, and its solubility, mechanical properties, heat resistance and ablative heat insulation properties of the composite were tested. The effect of resin structure on its properties was studied. Compared with methyl phenolic resin, boron modified phenolic resin not only has better solubility and mechanical properties, but also increases the initial decomposition temperature and peak decomposition temperature by 170°C, the carbon residue rate by 11.11%, and improves the ablative heat insulation performance of the composite. The linear ablative rate is 0.0003333 mm s-l, and the mass ablative rate is 0.0002733 g s-l, The back temperature of 4mm sheet is 110°C after 10 min of gas oxygen ablation, which is expected to be used as the matrix resin of thermal protection materials.

articleTitle: 1×4 Optical Demultiplexer for TM Modes in a Hole-Type Silicon Photonic Crystal
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Based on the self-collimation (SC) effect of photonic crystals (PC), a two-dimensional photonic crystal $1\times 4$ optical demultiplexer (OD) with a second energy band in TM polarization mode is designed. The $1\times 4$ OD consists of two cascaded MachZehnder interferometers (MZIs) and an independent mirror. The theoretical formula of the output ports transmission spectrum is derived from the principle of optical interference, and the output ports are numerically simulated by the finite difference time domain (FDTD) method. The simulated transmission spectrum results are consistent with the theory. Choosing the correct cavity length ratio of MZIs can realize the function of a $1\times 4$ OD. The structural size of the $1\times 4$ OD is very small, about $57\mu \mathrm{m}\times 50\mu \mathrm{m}$. When the central working wavelength is 1550nm, the free spectral region (FSR) of the $1\times 4$ OD is about 23nm, almost covering the entire C-band window of optical communication, which has potential application value in the future optical communication field.

articleTitle: Time-Frequency Characteristic Analysis of Raman Spectrum Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Raman spectrum signal is a kind of scattering signal based on molecular vibration. It is a typical non-stationary signal and considering the scattering frequency shift, the effective information of Raman spectrum is mainly concentrated in the high frequency band. But Raman scattering is very weak, the effective signal is easily disturbed by high frequency noise and low frequency fluorescence background, in order to obtain effective Raman signal, it is necessary to process the signal. Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), appears to be a novel signal processing method for nonlinear and non-stationary signals, by decomposing signal into a small number of independent Intrinsic Modes Functions (IMFs) based on scale separation. Ensemble EMD (EEMD) is a substantial improvement of EMD which can better separate the scales naturally by adding white noise signals to the original signals and then treating the ensemble averages as the true intrinsic modes. In this paper, we extend EEMD to Raman spectrum signal analysis. Raman spectrum signals are decomposed and processed by EEMD, and a total of 10 orders IMFs from high frequency to frequency are obtained. According to the energy distribution and amplitude characteristics of the signal, we enhance and reconstruct the characteristics of the effective signal components, and also, we use Partial Least Squares (PLS) method to deduct the baseline of the signal. Through the above processing, the characteristic of vibration mode of the corresponding molecule group is significantly provided, which provides an effective means for further Raman information recognition.

articleTitle: Investigation into Adjustable Dissipative Soliton Resonance Generation in Double-Pumped Figure Eight Cavity Using Nonlinear Amplifying Loop Mirror
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We have proposed and demonstrated a figure-S dual-pumped passively mode-locked fiber laser to generate square wave pulse, the width of which can be turned non-linearly by pump power in each ring respectively or cooperatively, that indicated the relation of competition, coexistence and variable gain saturation in the generation of dissipative soliton resonance square-wave pulse.

articleTitle: Study on Fiber Optic Sensor for Ethanol Gas Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The combination of gas sensitive material and fiber optic sensor to realize human breath test is one of the important ways in breath testing. Therefore, this paper takes use of perovskite doping assisted by ultraviolet irradiation to improve the optical fiber sensitivity as to fabricate a kind of ethanol gas sensor involved by single-mode multimode single-mode fiber optic and to conduct verification, which explores the gas sensitive performance of the combination of fiber optic and new type composite materials. In the condition of ordinary temperature with ultraviolet irradiation, the ethanol gas could be measured accurately and stabled by selecting flower shaped ZnSnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> doped with TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>.

articleTitle: MZ Fiber Optic Temperature Sensor Based on Staggered Fusion Double Cone Type
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a MZ interferometric fiber temperature sensor based on staggered fusion splice and double cone, in which the required single-mode fiber-multimode fiber-seven-core fiber-single-mode fiber (S-M-TTSc-S) sensing unit structure is fabricated by discharge dissolution splice method and hydroxide flame fusion pulling cone method, and the higher-order mode is excited by the staggered fusion splice, and then the strong swift field characteristics of the cone region are used to fully interact with the external environment to perform temperature sensing. The experimental results show that the temperature response characteristics of the designed single-mode fiber-multimode fiber-seven-core fiber-single-mode fiber sensing unit are investigated in the temperature range of 26~36°C, and the effect of different girdle diameters on the temperature sensitivity is explored, resulting in the highest wavelength sensitivity of about 287.06 pm/°C with $\mathrm{R}^{2}=$0.99208. The sensor has the advantages of high sensitivity, fabrication simple, low cost and other advantages, which has potential applications in temperature detection.

articleTitle: Research and Dynamic Demonstration Test of One-Point to Multi-Point Space Laser Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to achieve multi-target simultaneous laser communication, research on one-to-many laser communication systems is carried out. The overall scheme and working principle of the system are introduced. A multi-target acquisition, pointing and tracking system (APT) based on optical antennas and fast steering mirrors (FSM) is designed, and the mirror linkage control method is adopted to improve the utilization efficiency of optical antennas. We have developed a prototype of the principle and carried out a dynamic demonstration experiment of One-Point to Multi-Point laser communication. The results show that the tracking accuracy of the APT system is better than $6\mu \mathrm{rad}$, the bit error rate under 2. 5Gbps communication rate is better than 1E-7. The experiment successfully established the One-Point to Two-Point laser communication link and carried out video transmission, which verified the feasibility of the One-Point to Multi-Point laser communication technology.

articleTitle: Model Optimization of Servo System Based on Internal Model Control
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the anti-interference ability of the servo system, the Internal Model Control(IMC) is applied to the turntable servo system. The strategy takes the velocity loop simplified by using the current loop as the control object, and uses the IMC to give the desired trajectory of the system out put. By introducing the IMC scheme into the servo system, the strategy can reduce the effects of model errors and external disturbances on the system, and enhanced the system’s anti-disturbances ability. The design procedures of the proposes controller and the structure of the closed-loop control system are given. The high performance of the proposed strategy is validated by comparative simulations. The simulation results showed that the proposed strategy has strong robustness to system parameter perturbation, and has higher stability accuracy and robustness than Proportion Integration Differentiation(PID) control.

articleTitle: Analysis of Communication Link’s Performance of Visible Light Intelligent Transportation System in Sandy Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, the performance of the communication link of visible light Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) in sandy environment is studied. $\beta$ is angle between the traffic light axis and the communication link (from traffic lights to vehicles),the relationship between received power at vehicle end and $\beta$ was first analyzed. Then the variation of the background light noise during a day was analyzed. Finally the relationship between Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)/Bit Error Rate (BER) and the visibility in sandy environment during a day was analyzed. The results show that the received power of vehicle decreases with the increase of $\beta$.During a day, background light noise increases and then decreases from 7:00 to 18:30, and reaches the maximum value of about 16 dBm at about 13:00. The change trend of BER is the same, and the change trend of SNR is the opposite. When the visibility is 4km, the maximum difference of SNR between 7:00 and 13:00 is about 20dB, and the maximum difference of BER is about 5.36E-7. At 7:00, the maximum difference of SNR is about 59dB between the visibility of 4km and the visibility of 100km, and the maximum difference of BER is about 1.24E-7.Finally, based on the optical transmission characteristics, a scheme for the visible light intelligent transportation system to adjust the transmitted power according to the real-time visibility is given.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Assisted Pre-equalization Scheme for Faster-than-Nyquist Optical Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Faster-than-Nyquist technology introduces additional inter-symbol interference when improving the data rate and spectrum utilization. A deep-learning based pre-equalization scheme is proposed to reduce the inter-symbol interference. The bit error rate performance under different acceleration factors is analyzed. Monte Carlo simulation results show that the bit error rate performance can be improved by 1dB, 5.1dB, 6. 0dB and 8. 6dB when the acceleration factor is 0.9, 0.8, 0.7 and 0.6, respectively.

articleTitle: Free Space Optical Communication System Based on the Combination of WDM and Polarization Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Free space optical communication system (FSO) is a data transmission technology that requires a straight line of sight between the transmitter and receiver for reliable transmission. FSO link h-as the advantage of high modulation bandwidth, high data transmission rate, low cost and simple installation process. In this paper, the combination of wavelength division multiplexing and polarization Multiplexed for space optical communication is studied to explore the performance of the system. The system performance is evaluated using various performance indices like eye diagram, Q factor and BER. with acceptable performance levels (when the laser power is 27dBm, Q~6dB and BER $\leq10^{-9}$).

articleTitle: Position-Marked Layered Optical Spatial Modulation with Pulse Position Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A position-marked layered optical spatial modulation (P-MLOSM) scheme is proposed to improve the spatial resource (SR) utilization and optimize the bit error rate (BER) of existing optical spatial modulation (OSM) systems. In the proposed scheme, the layered spatial structure increases the lasers utilization rate, and the time slots within each period of pulse position modulation (PPM) are extended to distinguish different layers in order to guaranteeing BER performance. The BER upper bound of P-MLOSM scheme is derived under the Gamma-Gamma fading channel and simulated by Monte Carlo method. Simulation results show that the BER performance of (5$\times$ 4-2-2) PMLOSM system is improved by about 1.5 dB at BER=1$\times10^{-4}$ compared with that of (5$\times$ 4-2-2) layered optical spatial modulation (LOSM) system.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Unmanned Marine Vessels Based on Improved Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the increasing development of the shipping industry, the research on perfecting the route planning behavior of unmanned ships has become increasingly important. Path planning is an important part of unmanned ship navigation. Its goal is to enable the unmanned ship to find a collision-free path from the starting point to the end point in a more complicated environment. In this paper, by improving the Q-learning algorithm, it can search in multiple directions, avoiding the local optimum to a large extent, and making the turning trajectory smoother. By modifying the iteration parameters, the efficiency of the algorithm is improved, the optimal path planning can be made in a short time, and the results can be analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on Luminescence Properties of Eu³⁺/Tb³⁺ Doped Gadolinium Barium Borosilicate Glass
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Transparent Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped gadolinium barium borosilicate glasses were synthesized by the high-temperature melting technique. The luminescence performance was studied by transmittance, photoluminescence excitation and emission spectrum, and decay time curve. The optimal concentration of Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions in gadolinium barium borosilicate glasses was also determined. With the increase of Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions concentration, the lifetime of Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> decreases from 1.77±0.005 ms to 1.56±0.005 ms. The minimum and maximum of the critical distance Rc of rare earth ions in gadolinium barium borosilicate glass is calculated. Therefore, the energy transfer mechanism of rare earth ions in gadolinium barium borosilicate glass is multipole-multipole interaction.

articleTitle: Free Space Laser Communication Equalizer Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the performance degradation of space laser communication system caused by atmospheric turbulence, a deep learning method based on deep neural network (DNN) has proposed an equalization algorithm for the fourth-order pulse position modulation (4PPM) signal of space laser communication. Using the atmospheric turbulence pool to simulate the atmospheric turbulence, carry out the hardware-in-the-loop simulation experiment to obtain the data signal, and use the DNN equalization algorithm to process the data offline. Experiments show that the DNN equalizer can effectively compensate the nonlinear distortion of the atmospheric channel, and its equalization performance is better than other traditional equalizers under different intensities of atmospheric turbulence. It has good performance and the bit error rate can reach $10^{-6}$.

articleTitle: Measurement of Lateral Wind Speed in Atmospheric Turbulence Using PIV Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: To address the problem that the lateral wind in atmospheric turbulence is the main factor affecting the laser transmission in the atmospheric channel, a method based on PIV particle image velocimetry is proposed to obtain the lateral wind in the laser transmission path. The theoretical calculation of the moving displacement of the spot image using the PIV particle image velocimetry technique is carried out, and the results show that the method can well reflect the influence mechanism of the lateral wind in the process of measuring the lateral wind, so that the change of the displacement vector can also be reflected while calculating the change of the lateral wind speed.1

articleTitle: MoTe₂ Microfilm Terahertz Detector at Room Temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Terahertz detectors are attracting widespread attention due to the special frequency of terahertz waves between microwaves and infrared waves. However, the problems such as small detection area, difficulty in repeatable preparation, high noise equivalent power as well as the requirement for cooling system still exist. In order to fulfill this requirement, Weyl semimetal MoTe2 was chosen as the active layer in this work due to its narrow bandgap and Weyl-point enhancement. In this work, the fabircation of high-quality and large-scale (1 mm $\times$ 6.3 mm) MoTe2-based THz detectors realized with the magnetron sputtering deposition method. Addtionally, with an external voltage applied, our device exhibits obvious excitation of light current for THz detection and demonstrates a photoresponse of 2.65 A/W and a noise equivalent power of $16.84 \times 10^{-12}$ W Hz$^{-1/2}$ under the illumination of 0.1 THz wave at room temperature. Our research paves the way to the fabrication of large-scale THz detectors, also proves that the Weyl semimetal possess enormous potential in long-wave detection.

articleTitle: Study on 1.5μm Laser Properties of Er³⁺/Yb³⁺ Co-doped Fluoroaluminophosphate Glass Fiber Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped glass is a good gain dielectric material for $1.5\mu \mathrm{m}$ laser fiber amplifiers. In this paper, Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped fluoroaluminophosphate glasses were prepared by high temperature melting and equal component replacement. Under the 980nm LD, $1.5\mu \mathrm{m}$ laser characteristics were studied. The results show that the $1.5\mu \mathrm{m}$ emission is greatly affected by the ratio of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doping concentration. When the Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doping molar ratio is 1 mol%: 5 mol%, the maximum fluorescence intensity is achieved. And the absorption cross section and emission cross section are 2.075 pm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 1.11 pm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, respectively. The gain coefficient is 1.649 mspm2. Meanwhile, the fluorescence half-height width is 48. 3nm, and the fluorescence lifetime is 2. 08ms. The results show that Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped fluoroaluminophosphate glass material is an excellent gain medium material for high gain, high bandwidth and high flatness fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Research on Intracavity Cascade Pumping Three-Wave Mixing Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We report a three-wave mixing laser based on intracavity cascade pumping technique. A coaxial linear resonator structure is applied in this laser. 808nm laser diode (LD)is used to end-pump Nd:YAG crystal to obtain 946nm laser, then 946nm laser is used to directly pump Yb:YAG crystal in cavity to realize the stable operation of946nm and 1030nm dual-wavelength lasers involved in mixing. Nonlinear crystal LBO is used to perform intracavity sum-frequency generation of 946/1030nm dual-wavelength lasers. Under the condition of type-I phase-matching, the optimal phase matching angle of the LBO crystal is calculated as $6=90^{\circ}, \varphi=16.4^{\circ}$, and maximum effective nonlinear coefficient is $8.21\times 10^{-13}\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{V}$ At 25W pump power, 384. 5mW, 493nm continuous wave laser output is obtained, and the corresponding optical-optical conversion efficiency is 1.54%; the beam quality factors of the output laser in X and Y directions are $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{x}}^{2}=1.36$ and $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{y}}^{2}=1.39$ respectively; the power fluctuation within 4 hours is better than 3.6%. The experimental results show that the compact intracavity cascade pumped three-wave mixing laser can achieve efficient and stable blue laser output.

articleTitle: Campus Sentiment Analysis with GAN-based Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Recent advances have seen the rapid development of online media, which offers various communication channels for people to express opinions. The fast-growing social media platforms have generated tremendous data that can be transformed into business and social value through modern machine learning algorithms. One of the crucial learning tasks is sentiment analysis, which refers to identifying the tendency of subjective information in an expression. Prior efforts in sentiment classification have explored a broad spectrum of methods that have achieved impressive performance gains from the predictive modeling perspective. However, the potential of data augmentation has not been sufficiently explored in this task, and we aim to fill this gap. This study proposes a novel sentiment analysis framework powered by two performance boosters, including a data augmentation method based on a transformer-based generative adversarial network (GAN) and RoBERTa, a robustly optimized Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) pretraining model, to improve the prediction accuracy from both the data and the model side. We conduct extensive experiments on a campus sentiment classification dataset. We show that the GAN-based data augmentation method can generate high-quality synthetic samples to increase the size and diversity of the training set. Compared with other model options and augmentation methods, the RoBERTa model enhanced by transformer-based GAN (TransGAN) presents a superior performance in prediction accuracy, validating the efficacy of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Study on Secure Communication of Internet of Vehicles Based on Identity-Based Cryptograph
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Driven by the current computer technology and communication technology, traditional cars are equipped with sensors and communication equipment to realize the communication between cars and cars or between cars and infrastructure. It not only brings various information services to cars, but also improves road safety and traffic efficiency. However, as the security of Internet of Vehicles(IoVs) application service depends on the security of communication network, any malicious network attack will cause great harm to it. Therefore, it is of great significance to provide a reliable solution for the secure communication of vehicles. Our goal is to study a secure communication system between vehicle and infrastructure. In need of low bandwidth and low latency of the vehicle and infrastructure scenario, the communication between vehicle and infrastructure is convenient and safety. We propose a secure communication scheme for IoVs based on Identity-Based Cryptograph(IBC). It provides data encryption and access control between the vehicle and the system. The vehicle records contain sensitive information about the owner and the vehicle in the form of encryption. It not only solves the problem of unsafe communication between IoVs and infrastructure, but also realizes the safe communication of IoVs. Moreover, the crypto center and several key secrecy organizations are proposed to improve the trust of the key generation center and improve the insecurity of communication.

articleTitle: Challenges of Ship Network Security in the Current
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The rapid development of ship informatization reduces the cost and improves the system performance, but the disadvantage is that it will produce a new network environment. In this environment, network attackers can take advantage of lower risk to obtain more profits. At present, maritime related personnel have begun to realize the importance of ship network security, but the awareness of ship network risk is still relatively small. In this paper, through the summary of ship network security attackers and ship network security vulnerabilities, some suggestions and strategies for the future development of ship network security are put forward.

articleTitle: Flexible Frame Structure to Support Vertical Industries in C-Band
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Unprecedented services and applications produced in the fourth industrial revolution are changing the way we live, work, and communicate with each other. Given that the communication mechanisms associated with these new applications and services are very different from traditional human-centric communications, NR frame structure need to provide a flexible and efficient enough way to accommodate all the requirements of various traffic. In this paper contributes to compare three characteristic frame structures in terms of latency and throughput, respectively. The simulation results reveal that three frame structures have different advantages, thus operators can select a suitable frame structure to meet the requirements from vertical industry customers.

articleTitle: Error Analysis and Performance Simulation of Quantum Satellite Positioning System under Snowfall Background
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to study the influence of snowfall on quantum positioning system, according to snowflake model and Mie scattering theory, the extinction coefficient of snowflake is defined, and the relationship between signal attenuation, snowfall intensity and transmission distance of quantum positioning system under different zenith angles is established. The mathematical models of positioning error, snowfall intensity and transmission distance are established through the opening angle of two quantum satellite baselines relative to users. The simulation results show that the signal of quantum positioning system attenuates with the increase of snowfall intensity and zenith angle, and the positioning error increases with the increase of snowfall intensity. Properly adjusting the opening angle can reduce the positioning error of users. Finally, the mathematical model between snowfall intensity, transmission distance and channel fidelity are established. The simulation results show that the minimum fidelity is not less than 0.9, which provides a theoretical basis for the impact of snow on quantum satellite positioning system. Therefore, in order to improve the reliability of quantum positioning system, the parameters of quantum satellite positioning system should be adjusted adaptively according to the relevant parameters of snowfall.

articleTitle: Research on Composite Tracking Control Technology of Single Detector in Laser Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The premise of space laser communication is the precise alignment of beacon beam, so the tracking technology of the composite axis is the key, and the coupling problem of coarse and fine composite tracking has become the research focus. Designed a tracking system based on single detector composite axis, and explained its principle and key technology. The method of coarse tracking and compensation to compensate fine tracking deflection amount is used to solve the coupling problem. The “open window” function of CCD(Charge Coupled Device) detector is adopted to solve the different requirements of the main axis and the sub-axis to the detector. The prediction of target trajectory during field of view switching improves the stability and greatly broadens the application scenarios of the system compared with the traditional method of single detector compound axis. An experimental system is built to verify the tracking performance and indicators. The experimental results show that the system’s coarse tracking error is controlled within 300$\mu$rad and the fine tracking error is controlled within 1 pixel under the disturbance of ±5°@0.1Hz. Combining the actual conditions, the overall tracking accuracy of the system is better than 3urad, which can realize accurate tracking of the beacon light and meet the application requirements of space laser communication.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Self-Phase Locking Laser in the Fabrication of Micro-Nano Structures of Scaffolds
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The use of drug-eluting stents for percutaneous coronary intervention is the most effective method for the treatment of coronary heart disease. The micro-nano structure on the surface of the coronary stent can realize the storage and controlled release of the loaded drugs. Efficient preparation technology of micro-nano structures on the surface of coronary stents has become a current research hotspot. In this paper, we analyzed the self-locking mechanism of the dual-channel mutual injection solid-state laser, and built a four-beam interference processing system using the laser as the light source to process the surface of the material silicon. In this paper, we analyzed the self-phase locking mechanism of a dual-channel mutual injection solid-state laser. And a four-beam interference processing system with the laser as the light source was built to process the surface of the material silicon. When the working wavelength is 1064nm, the pulse width is 8.1ns, the energies of the four lasers are 78mJ, 86mJ,88mJ, 80mJ respectively, and the exposure time and repetition frequency are set at 60s and 10Hz, we have obtained periods of 3.94$\mu$m and 3.11 $\mu$m hole array structure. This result provides support for subsequent drug-loading experiments on stents, and has positive significance in promoting micro-nano-multiple interference processing technology.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2021 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The 13th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT) was held at Yanji City, Jilin Province, China during Oct. 15-18, 2021. ICAIT 2021 is co-sponsored by Changchun University of Science and Technology and IEEE Photonics Society. ICAIT 2021 aims to provide a platform for the discussing the issues, challenges, opportunities, and findings of advanced infocomm technology. The ever-changing scope and rapid development of infocomm technology create new problem and questions, resulting in the real needs for sharing brilliant ideas and simulating good awareness of this important research field. All the submissions of conference were subjected to peer-reviewing, there are 44 full papers were accepted for publication. We would like to express our gratitude and appreciation for all the reviewers who helped us maintain the high quality of manuscripts included in the proceedings. We would also like to extent our thanks to all the members of the organizing team for their hard work. The proceedings focus on original high-quality research in the realm of infocomm technology, from theoretical aspects to application-dependent studies and the validation of emerging technologies. It is intended as a forum for practitioners and researchers to share electronics technology applications and solutions in the area, to identify new issues and to shape future directions for research, while industrial users may apply techniques of leading-edge, large-scale, high-performance infocomm technology.
